policy: Dependencies are architectural relationships only. They do not establish runtime interoperability. A dependency becomes tested only after pinned, reproducible cross-repository tests and evidence are published.

breaking_change_policy: Major versions may change representation or reconstruction semantics; minor versions add backward-compatible fields and capabilities; patch versions correct non-semantic defects. Never silently change an exactness guarantee.
